prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Kansas City Missouri for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your exact needs (age, complexity of your case), location, budget and preferences. I can help you find the best option near you if you tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you want braces or Invisalign. Meanwhile, here’s a quick plan to find a top orthodontist in Kansas City, MO and what to look for.

How to find top orthodontists near you
- Use these official/credible searches:
  - American Association of Orthodontists “Find an Orthodontist” (aaoinfo.org)  
  - Invisalign provider locator (invisalign.com) if you want aligners  
  - Google Maps, Yelp, Healthgrades, Zocdoc for patient reviews and photos
- Ask friends, family, or your general dentist for recommendations.

What to check about any orthodontist
- Specialty training: they should be an orthodontist (DDS/DMD + orthodontic residency), not just a general dentist offering braces.  
- Board certification: American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification is a strong indicator of excellence (search ABO diplomates).  
- Invisalign experience: check provider level/qualifications on Invisalign site (Diamond/Platinum tiers show volume) and ask how many cases like yours they’ve treated.  
- Before/after photos of similar cases.  
- Patient reviews and how the office handles emergencies, follow-ups, and retention (retainer policies).  
- Technology and comfort: digital scans (no goopy impressions), 3D imaging, clear aligner options, ceramic/braces options.  
- Cost, financing, insurance handling, estimated treatment time, and warranty/guarantee.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Can you show before/after photos of patients with cases like mine?  
- Are you ABO-board certified or preparing for certification?  
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year (if considering Invisalign)?  
- What’s the expected treatment time and total cost? Any additional fees?  
- What’s your emergency policy if a bracket breaks or an aligner is lost?  
- What retainer will I get and what is the long-term follow-up plan?

If you want, I can:
- Look up the top-rated orthodontists in Kansas City (need your ZIP or neighborhood), or  
- Compile a short list of 3–5 highly rated local providers with links, review summaries, and contact details so you can book consultations.

Which would you prefer?
